title: Telegram Update
description: Represents an incoming update from Telegram. At most one of the optional parameters can be present in any given update.

update_id.description: The update's unique identifier. Update identifiers start from a certain positive number and increase sequentially.

message.description: New incoming message of any kind — text, photo, sticker, etc.

edited_message.description: New version of a message that is known to the bot and was edited.

channel_post.description: New incoming channel post of any kind — text, photo, sticker, etc.

edited_channel_post.description: New version of a channel post that is known to the bot and was edited.

callback_query.description: New incoming callback query from an inline keyboard button.

poll.description: New poll state. Bots receive only updates about stopped polls and polls which are sent by the bot.

my_chat_member.description: The bot's chat member status was updated in a chat.

chat_member.description: A chat member's status was updated in a chat.

chat_join_request.description: A request to join the chat has been sent.

message_id.description: Unique message identifier inside the chat

date.description: Date the message was sent in Unix time

text.description: For text messages, the actual UTF-8 text of the message

message.description: Message sent by the bot with the callback button that originated the query

inline_message_id.description: Identifier of the message sent via the bot in inline mode

chat_instance.description: Global identifier of the chat that triggered the callback

data.description: Data associated with the callback button (0-64 bytes)

query.description: Text of the query (up to 256 characters)

offset.description: Offset of the results to be returned, can be controlled by the bot

chat_type.description: Type of the chat from which the inline query was sent

total_voter_count.description: Total number of users that voted in the poll

is_closed.description: True if the poll is closed

is_anonymous.description: True if the poll is anonymous

allows_multiple_answers.description: True if the poll allows multiple answers

date.description: Date the change was done in Unix time

old_chat_member.description: Previous information about the chat member

new_chat_member.description: New information about the chat member

invite_link.description: Chat invite link used to join the chat

chat.description: Chat to which the request was sent

from.description: User that sent the join request

user_chat_id.description: Identifier of a private chat with the user

date.description: Date the request was sent in Unix time

invite_link.description: Chat invite link that was used by the user to send the join request
